description: Defines a `Note` class representing a local note with properties such as id, title, body, creation and update timestamps, along with serialization/deserialization methods.

classes.name: Note
classes.description: Represents a local note with title, body, and timestamps, including methods for creation, serialization, and deserialization.

methods.description: Factory constructor to create a new note with the current timestamp.

methods.description: Constructs a `Note` instance from a Map, handling missing fields with defaults.
